findings.title: North-run base frames sit at the SEKTION leg minimum with an unspecified 1.319 in gap under the stone

evidence.measured: Frame top = 3.5 (leg) + 30 = 33.5 AFF; stone underside 34.819 AFF (z0 of CT-M-KIT-N/NE/E in model). 1.319 in of unspecified build-up. K1 says 'no extra filler substrate under the quartz'; ladder note calls it 'approximately 1.319 substrate'; the only subtop in the takeoff is cabinet-peninsula-bar-subtop. IKEA leg 905.560.71 adjusts 3 1/2 to 5 1/8 in, so 3.5 is the minimum: no room to lower a leg on a high floor spot.
evidence.expected: Same stack as the peninsula (K6): 4 in legs + 30 frame + 3/4 ply subtop + 1/16 setting = 34.8125 vs 34.819, and legs mid-range. Or legs at 4.82 (in range) but the 4 1/2 in FORBATTRA toe kick then shows a 0.32 in gap.
evidence.method: Probe: countertops z0_m/z1_m in model.json (34.819/36.0 AFF); IKEA leg page https://www.ikea.com/us/en/p/sektion-leg-for-cabinet-90556071/ (fetched 2026-10-31); grep subtop prices.toml/takeoff.json

findings.source: IKEA US SEKTION leg 905.560.71 page; notes/kitchen_stock_cabinet_details.md K6
findings.proposed_fix: Spec the north run like the peninsula: legs 4 in, 3/4 in ply subtop under the stone (sink base: rails per cutout), add a priced subtop allowance; state it in K1 and the ladder note. Envelope heights stay 36.

evidence.method: Probe p2.py footprints; clear_face segments from model.rooms RM-M-LIVING (p3.py)

findings.source: appliance_types.py _FRIGIDAIRE_SOURCE (Frigidaire spec rev 10/21); width 32 7/8 confirmed via retailer listings (townappliance, tascoappliance)

findings.title: Sink opening sits 1.1 in behind the SEKTION sink-base frame front; top front rail/sink support interference unproven

evidence.measured: Flange front y=402.49, bowl opening front 403.49; sink-base frame front 401.375, so flange is 1.1 in and the stone opening 2.1 in behind the frame front. A 30x17 bowl in a 24 in box leaves the front steel top rail under the flange/clips; IKEA reviews report the front-centre sink support is weak at 32 in sinks. Note says 'no cabinet side or rail cutting is specified'.
evidence.expected: Rail width and clip fit confirmed from the IKEA sink-base drawing or a dry-fit; Kraus clip kit needs the rail clear or a support added.
evidence.method: Probe sink fixture footprint 336-368 x 402.5-424.5; IKEA sink base listing s79454366 reviews (no rail dimension published)

findings.source: Not confirmed: IKEA publishes no rail width. KHU100-32 32x19, bowl 30x17x10, 36 in min cabinet confirmed (AJ Madison/Home Depot).
findings.proposed_fix: Add a dry-fit hold: confirm rail vs opening before drilling; plan a ply sink-support strip under the front stone web.
